name: PointCast Make
description: Art configurators. Turn a few controls, keep the piece. Everything is drawn in the browser from a seed, and the whole piece lives in the link.

tools.title: Guilloché note engraver
tools.line: Lathe-work rosettes, a woven border and a cartouche for your word. Specimen, not money.

tools.title: Sticker slap maker
tools.line: A die-cut street sticker in two or three inks, with a cut line, at 300 dpi.

tools.title: Signal card maker
tools.line: A radio contact card: call sign, dial, scope trace, date stamp.

tools.title: Drum wheel
tools.line: A rhythm poster you can play. The link carries the beat.

tools.title: 1-bit Dither Studio
tools.line: Turn a photo or a generated scene into two-ink bitmap art with Atkinson, Floyd-Steinberg, Bayer or threshold dithering. Photos never leave your device.

tools.title: Punch-Card Loom
tools.line: Punch an 80-column card by tapping or typing a phrase, and the holes weave a textile repeat. Export the cloth as PNG or SVG.

tools.title: Moon and Tide Mood Card
tools.line: A pixel moon, a sun arc and a tide-like band for any date and latitude band, in colours that follow the hour. Approximate, not a tide table.

tools.title: Court Lines Poster
tools.line: A pickleball court at true 20 by 44 foot proportions as a two-colour poster, with a seeded rally traced across it.
